converters.certificate: the LIVE row names a certificate the canon does not hold: the promoter re-derives it (research/promoter.py) or the canon seal re-publishes it
converters.mechanism_class: declare the family's cause in desks/mt5/research/alpha_genome.py MECHANISM_CLASS (the style library owner)
converters.novelty: research/style_novelty.py on the host that holds the symbol's bars -- the box's hourly leg style_novelty; --force when the report predates the cert
converters.fill_cost: research/cost_surface.py on the box (it reads the symbol's spread column); a symbol absent from the surface needs its bars collected first
converters.tradability: refresh data/universe/universe.json from MT5 symbol_info on the box (the universe refresh leg); a symbol the venue no longer lists is RETIRED upstream, never left blank here
converters.forward_clock: research/forward_enrolment.py (hourly, after the judge) enrols every certificate; scripts/check_certificate_clock_law.py re-reads it
converters.pnl_attribution: research/daily_cycle.py writes markout.json and attribution_chain.json from the account's deals; research/attribution_reconcile.py routes the unattributed ones
